description: Let's build something unique and competitive together!
summary: Safe Cycle is a multilingual crop-rotation decision-support app for Moroccan farmers. Farmers select a field on a map, choose crops and priorities, and compare rotation options with plain-language explanations, evidence and risk warnings. The app combines 20 years of NASA POWER climate data with ISRIC SoilGrids soil properties, FAOSTAT crop prices and yields, and MODIS satellite greenness. It estimates reference evapotranspiration using the FAO-56 method and uses transparent scoring and optimization to explore water, soil, income, erosion and forage goals. The interface is available in French, Arabic and English. Safe Cycle supports farmers’ decisions; it does not replace their experience or local agricultural advice.
details: Safe Cycle helps Moroccan farmers explore crop rotations for a selected location. It uses NASA POWER climate data to estimate reference evapotranspiration and compare crop water needs with rainfall; this helps assess water deficits and suggest sowing windows. Farmers can compare rotation options, review reasons and risks, and optimize plans across multiple parcels. MODIS satellite greenness is shown as additional context. Soil information comes from ISRIC SoilGrids, and crop prices and yields come from FAOSTAT. The app is built with React/Vite, Django REST/Python, and Pyomo with HiGHS, and supports French, Arabic and English. OpenAI Codex assisted with software development, debugging, and drafting project text; the team ran tests on the software. The underlying measurements come from the cited data sources, not AI-generated farm data. Recommendations are decision support, not yield predictions or a substitute for local expertise.
dataRefs: NASA MODIS MOD13Q1 NDVI via ORNL DAAC
